data.notes: June 2026 is especially strong in Los Angeles thanks to Pride weekend, World Cup fan programming, Hollywood Bowl season openers, and major arena pop/Latin/hip-hop tours.

events.title: Ariana Grande: The Eternal Sunshine Tour
events.summary: Ariana Grande brings The Eternal Sunshine Tour to Crypto.com Arena for two confirmed Los Angeles dates, June 13 and 14.

events.title: Shakira: Las Mujeres Ya No Lloran World Tour 2026
events.summary: Shakira plays two arena dates at Intuit Dome in Inglewood on June 13 and 14 as part of her Las Mujeres Ya No Lloran World Tour 2026.

events.title: Blue Note Jazz Festival at the Hollywood Bowl
events.summary: Blue Note’s Hollywood Bowl weekend features jazz, soul, funk, and R&B programming; confirmed artists include Patti LaBelle, Wyclef Jean, Gregory Porter, Samara Joy, Yussef Dayes, Cimafunk, Robert Glasper presents R+R=NOW, and Kokoroko.

events.title: OUTLOUD Music Festival at WeHo Pride
events.summary: Three-day WeHo Pride music festival headlined by The Pussycat Dolls, JADE, and Ava Max at West Hollywood Park.

events.title: ROSALÍA: LUX Tour 2026
events.summary: ROSALÍA’s LUX Tour 2026 is listed at Kia Forum with a Los Angeles-area run beginning June 29 and continuing July 1.

events.title: FIFA Fan Festival Los Angeles
events.summary: Official FIFA Fan Festival for the World Cup opening weekend in Los Angeles, with live match broadcasts, musical performances, cultural programming, and fan activations at the Coliseum.

events.title: LA Block Party: Keyshia Cole, Mario, Fabolous, Danity Kane, Twista & More
events.summary: A 21+ outdoor R&B and hip-hop block party in Downtown LA with Keyshia Cole, Mario, Fabolous, Danity Kane, Twista, Juelz Santana, Petey Pablo, Lil Mo, Nivea, food trucks, bars, and vendors.

events.title: Red Bull Midsummer LA
events.summary: Red Bull’s global Midsummer electronic series lands in Los Angeles with TOKiMONSTA, Austin Millz, Noodles, Baile World, Pangea Sound, STRAWBRY & Friends, heds, and THE 9AM BANGER listed on the schedule.

events.title: Yoon Fest 2026
events.summary: YOON returns as an intimate three-day, three-night Southern California gathering with a 500-person cap, two stages, deep sound, and a lineup spanning Danny Daze, Brett Johnson, Janeret, Dylan Payne, Annika Wolfe, and more.

events.title: we own the night LA 15 year anniversary
events.summary: Long-running LA underground party We Own The Night celebrates 15 years with Rush Hour co-founder Antal, promising rare house, disco, acid, techno, art, and food near Downtown LA.

events.title: Diljit Dosanjh: Aura North American Tour 2026
events.summary: Punjabi superstar Diljit Dosanjh brings his Aura North American Tour 2026 to Crypto.com Arena for a June 18 arena show.

events.title: Don Toliver: Octane Tour
events.summary: Don Toliver’s Octane Tour is listed for a two-night Crypto.com Arena run on June 28 and 29.

events.title: A$AP Rocky: Don't Be Dumb World Tour
events.summary: A$AP Rocky plays Kia Forum in Inglewood on June 27 on the Don't Be Dumb World Tour.

events.title: WORK presents Compendium: Pleasurekraft [All Night Long]
events.summary: 6AM Group and Synthetik Minds bring Pleasurekraft back to the WORK Warehouse for an all-night, no-genre-boundaries Compendium set rooted in techno and progressive club pressure.

events.title: Dirty Epic and INCOGNITO present: Stacey Pullen, BAE BAE and Nish
events.summary: Dirty Epic and INCOGNITO team for a Detroit techno warehouse affair with Second Wave innovator Stacey Pullen, Hood Rave host BAE BAE, and Nish.

events.title: Chapstick
events.summary: A Pride mini-fest for lesbian and non-binary communities with Rico Nasty, Empress Of, Flyana Boss DJ set, and two-stage programming at The Bellwether.

events.title: Midnight Lovers Summer Day Party with Bradley Zero, Masha Mar, Mez Monty, James Axon
events.summary: Midnight Lovers opens summer with an extended outdoor day-into-night party under the Sixth Street Bridge, led by Bradley Zero with Masha Mar, Mez Monty b2b James Axon, Xica Soul b2b Maddy Maia, Extrachuy, and Planet Rolly.

events.title: CLOSER presents THERMAL with Aleroj, ELLA & 2DEEP
events.summary: CLOSER’s Latin-leaning THERMAL edition features Bogotá’s Aleroj with 2DEEP, ELLA, and Nat The F*kn Rat, connecting guaracha, reggaeton, juke, techno, hardcore, and underground perreo.

events.title: Palomazo Norteño: Clase Maestra Tour
events.summary: Palomazo Norteño brings the Clase Maestra Tour to Kia Forum on June 26.

events.title: TUNNEL Pride Weekender
events.summary: TUNNEL’s Pride Weekender is a two-night Los Angeles dance event with announced artists including LSDXOXO, Juliana Huxtable, Cece Natalie, Babymorocco, deBasement, River Moon, and OZA.
